newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basketball-Shell, Alaska beat rivals in quarterfinal.
newsitem.headline: Basketball-Shell, Alaska beat rivals in quarterfinal.

text.p: Formula Shell and Alaska Milk trounced their respective challengers on Friday night, ousting Purefoods Corned Beef and Mobiline from the quarterfinals race in the Philippine Basketball Association third conference series.
Shell's Benjie Paras led his team in both offensive and defensive cards, sinking in 19 points and posting his 1,000th block in his professional career during the game.
He joined Ramon Fernandez and Philip Cezar, both retired, who made more than 1,000 blocks in the league.
The victory elevated Shell to the lead with San Miguel Beer.
Defending champion Alaska Milk depended on import Sean Chambers and local Bong Hawkins to keep Mobiline at bay in the first game.
